subject: Vendr portal: remote evidence validation & S3 proofing
messages:
From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
To: Sam Hughes <sam.hughes@cloudpartner.com>
Cc: aditya_rao@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: 2028-03-22 09:15 -0700
Subject: Vendr portal: remote evidence validation & S3 proofing

Hi Sam,

Quick note from the security intake side — we started the Vendr profile review for CloudPartner (profile CP-4821) and noticed a handful of assertions flagged as "remote evidence" (S3 links / temporary credentials). Before we begin the CAIQ mapping I want to confirm the preferred approach for proof-of-possession and timelines:

- Can you provide a short-lived presigned bundle (one archive) containing the files that map to the CAIQ controls referenced in the profile?
- Ideally the bundle should be available for 72 hours. If presigned links aren’t feasible, we can accept a secure transfer instruction (SFTP or a temporary share).
- We also need a screenshot of the Vendr "Profile Assertions" view showing the delegation / owner assignment for the storage buckets (we'll attach to the evidence index).

Our timeline: if we receive the bundle or transfer details by EOD Thursday your profile can move to "verified (evidence pending)" and stay on schedule for the vendor security review next Tuesday.

Cc'ing Aditya (platform security) and Laura (portal ops) — they may have follow-up about manifest formatting and S3 prefixes.

Thanks,

Markus Klein
Director, Security Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Sam Hughes <sam.hughes@cloudpartner.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
Cc: security@cloudpartner.com
Date: 2028-03-22 12:03 -0700
Subject: Re: Vendr portal: remote evidence validation & S3 proofing

Markus —

Thanks for the clear note and the timeline. We can provide a presigned zip that contains the CAIQ-mapped artifacts. A few clarifications:

1) We'll include an evidence index (spreadsheet) that maps filenames to CAIQ control IDs.
2) We can make the presigned URL valid for 72 hours and share the root manifest (csv) in the same payload.
3) For the Vendr screenshot, do you need the audit trail (who uploaded) or the UI snapshot that shows owner assignment? We can capture both, but the audit trail will be an export (CSV) rather than an image.

We're prepping the bundle now. ETA for the presigned link is ~3pm PT today. If you need SFTP instead please let us know — we can provision a short-lived account.

Best,

Sam Hughes
Head of Security Operations
CloudPartner Inc.
From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
To: aditya_rao@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com
Cc: Sam Hughes <sam.hughes@cloudpartner.com>
Date: 2028-03-22 14:30 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Vendr portal: remote evidence validation & S3 proofing

Aditya / Laura — forwarding Sam's reply. Two quick asks for our side before they share the presigned bundle:

- Aditya: can you confirm the manifest shape we expect? Last intake we accepted columns: filename, size_bytes, sha256, caiq_control, path_in_bucket. If you want additional fields (e.g., object last_modified) say so.
- Laura: when you review the Vendr screenshot, prioritize: owner assignment, last assertion timestamp, and any "delegation" flags. We'll upload the screenshot and index to the profile.

I'll hold off confirming the 72-hour window until we see the link. Sam has offered SFTP as a fallback — good to have that in our checklist.

Thanks — Markus

From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>

Date: 2028-03-22 16:02 -0700
Subject: Re: Vendr portal: remote evidence validation & S3 proofing

Markus / Laura —

Manifest shape confirmed. Please ask CloudPartner to include these CSV columns in the s3-presign-manifest.csv: filename, path_in_bucket, size_bytes, sha256, caiq_control, last_modified_iso, uploader_email. That gives us everything needed to tie files to CAIQ assertions and to seed the CAIQ->Redwood verification mapping.

For the Vendr screenshot: the UI snapshot is sufficient for the profile; request the audit CSV as well if they can. We'll import the screenshot as vendr-assertion-screenshot.png and attach the manifest + index (caiq-evidence-index.xlsx) to the Vendr record.

If they opt for SFTP, ask them to provide host, username, password, and TTL (we'll rotate on import).

I'll take point on the ingestion once we have the presigned link.

Thanks,
Aditya Rao
Senior Security Engineer — Platform
Redwood Inference
